commands.description: Run inference on a Workers AI model. commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply any unapplied D1 migrations. Creates the bookkeeping table if absent, diffs the migration files under --dir against what the table records, and applies the rest in numeric order. Wire-compatible with `wrangler d1 migrations apply`: same table shape, same --dir-relative recorded names, same ordering. The database must be identified by ID; names and binding names are not accepted.

options.name: dir
options.description: Directory containing migration files (default: ./migrations)

options.name: pattern
options.description: Glob for discovering migration files. Defaults to "<dir>/*.sql"; Drizzle's nested layout uses "<dir>/*/migration.sql"

options.name: table
options.description: Table recording applied migrations; must use Wrangler's bookkeeping schema (default: d1_migrations)

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new empty D1 migration file, numbered one above the highest existing migration. Entirely local — takes no database, needs no credentials and makes no network calls. If an ORM manages your migrations, use its own generator instead; for Drizzle, use `drizzle-kit generate`.

options.name: dir
options.description: Directory containing migration files (default: ./migrations)

options.name: pattern
options.description: Glob the new file must match, so `apply` will pick it up

commands.description: List unapplied D1 migrations as JSON. Applies nothing.

options.name: table

commands.name: create
commands.description: Register a domain. Billable and non-refundable — a successful registration charges the account's default payment method. Input fields are extension-specific: they come from the extension's registration schema (`GET /registrar/extensions/{name}`) at run time, so run `cf registrar registrations create <domain> --help` to list the fields for that domain's extension, or pass a complete payload with --body. Required fields are prompted for interactively. Check availability and pricing first with `cf registrar domain-check`.

arguments.name: domain-name
arguments.description: Fully qualified domain name to register, e.g. example.travel

options.name: extension
options.description: Extension whose registration schema to use (default: derived from the domain)

options.name: prefer
options.description: Set the Prefer header, e.g. `respond-async` to skip the synchronous wait

options.name: force
options.description: Skip the registration confirmation prompt

options.name: body
options.description: Raw JSON request body, or @path to a JSON file. Use instead of the per-extension fields.

options.name: dry-run
options.description: Validate and show what would happen without executing

options.name: help
options.description: Show help, including this extension's input flags
